Name: Marnie and Lewis in the Shipping Bin
Author: lndnndrsn
Description:
Marnie and Mayor Lewis are at it again, this time inside your shipping bin!
Maybe they are trying to get back at you for displaying Lewis' "lucky purple shorts" at the Stardew Valley Fair.

This Mod works works with shipping bin re-textures and build-able shipping bins.

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and drop an item into your shipping bin!
